import sys

def dfs(node, parent, color, dists, dp):
    dp[node][color] = dists[color]
    max_dist = max(dists)
    for neighbor in graph[node]:

            new_dists = dists[:]
            new_dists[color] += 1
            dfs(neighbor, node, color, new_dists, dp)
            new_dists[color] -= 1
            new_dists[1-color] += 1
            dfs(neighbor, node, 1-color, new_dists, dp)
            new_dists[1-color] -= 1

def bfs(root, color, dp):
    queue = deque([(root, color)])
    visited = set([root])
    while queue:
        node, color = queue.popleft()
        dp[node][color] = max(dp[node][color], dp[root][color])
